statement: On the space of complete quadrics in P3, a quadric-tangency condition has divisor class q=2(p+l+h), where p,l,h impose incidence with a point, tangency to a line, and tangency to a plane. Consequently nine general quadric-tangency conditions have q^9=2^9 sum_(alpha+beta+gamma=9) [9!/(alpha!beta!gamma!)] p^alpha l^beta h^gamma=666841088 nonsingular complex solutions.
